purpose: Recomputes a white-label stablecoin deal's reserve-income split (issuer, platform, distributor, custodian) from aggregate declared values, a period of days with an average reserve value and an annual yield in basis points, or a declared reserve income, and each party's share in integer minor units, with a conservation check that the floored shares sum exactly to the income. Traces every declared holder-facing reward to its payer and funding source and flags any reward whose payer is an issuer class (issuer, permitted_issuer or foreign_issuer; any other payer role is refused) (enacted statutory profile: PL 119-27 § 4(a)(11) bars a permitted payment stablecoin issuer from paying a holder any form of interest or yield solely in connection with holding, using, or retaining the coin) or whose funding is an issuer flow (reserve income), returning NO_ISSUER_YIELD, REVIEW or ISSUER_YIELD_PRESENT. Adjacent: art-45's narrow genius_yield check inside the Arc xReserve linter flags a declared yield switch; reserve composition comes from art-06 and art-275. The node states facts about declared flows only; it never says a deal is lawful. Inputs are aggregate values and role labels only, no live addresses, no named counterparties, no real deal terms.
